spec.desc: One-storey primary school with bell cupola, 6x3
spec.prompt: Isometric 2:1 (Diablo II / Commandos camera) hand-painted pixel-art game sprite on a transparent background, Halloween night in 1990s American suburbia, cold blue moonlight from the upper-left, warm orange practical lights, crisp dark outline, no ground/background, no cast shadow (engine draws shadows). A friendly one-storey 1950s primary school, cream brick with a green trim band, a white bell cupola on the roof, big windows decorated with kids' paper pumpkins and bats, a sign reading HOLLOW CREEK PRIMARY over red double doors. Footprint 6x3 tile(s); footprint centre on pixel (318,384).

prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: isolated game building sprite. Image 1 is style reference, Image 2 is exact canvas and footprint layout guide, Image 3 is the school image to edit. Preserve Image 3's school building identity, sign, facade, windows, roof and cupola. REMOVE ALL background glow, fog, illumination haze and floor haze completely; genuinely transparent alpha outside physical building and its attached planters/steps ONLY. Do not replace with black or checkerboard. Do not add a ground patch or shadow. Fit building to Image 2's footprint, door position and exact 636:548 canvas proportions (e.g. 1272x1096), with footprint center exactly (636,768) at that output size. Camera orthographic 2:1 dimetric, no geometry skew. The full building must fit without clipping; preserve correct transparent padding rather than choosing a wide landscape canvas. One isolated building only. No extra objects, no changed text.
